response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country,'')) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g

assumptions.assumption: 'Award vote records' means player_award_vote, which has the foreign key to player. manager_award_vote is not used in the primary query.
A blank death country means NULL or an empty string. Both are merged into one group, shown as ''.

The comparison value is the unweighted mean of the per-group averages. Each group counts once, whatever its number of votes. Groups whose points_won are all NULL have a NULL average and are left out of that mean.
player.player_id is unique, so the inner join does not duplicate vote rows.

alternatives.interpretation: The vote records come from manager_award_vote, matched to player by player_id.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM manager_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country,'')) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g
